Applications open now
Applications open now
School leaver Scholarships for 2027 are now open!
If you are currently enrolled in Year 13 at a New Zealand secondary school or kura, you may be eligible for a scholarship for your first year of university study in 2027. Read more at
School leaver and first-year scholarships
.
You can now apply for Accommodation, so make sure you apply alongside your scholarship application.
Applications close at midday on Wednesday 12 August 2026.
Closing 11 August 2026
Arthritis NZ Mateponapona Aotearoa Summer Scholarships 2026/2027
Arthritis NZ will fund up to six Summer Scholarships in 2026/2027 which are worth $7,000 each. Students who are awarded Scholarships are usually in their final year of undergraduate study or undertaking some sort of postgraduate study at a recognised institution.
Research projects must be clearly related to arthritis with topics to be determined by supervisors. Applications are to be prepared by supervisors in advance of a Scholarship commencing as in most cases a student will not have been selected yet for an award. As with our grants, Summer Scholarship projects must also clearly align with Arthritis NZ’s key research objectives and Research Action Plan.
Read more and apply now
.
Closing 12 August 2026
Rutherford Science High Achiever Undergraduate Scholarship
A Scholarship for students enrolled in the second year of an undergraduate degree in the Faculty of Science who previously applied for a Top Achiever Scholarship.
Apply now
.
Society for Underwater Technology Scholarships
The Society for Underwater Technology awards a selection of scholarships every year, to recognise exceptional students and provide targeted financial support to see them complete their studies and start their career in the industry.
Applicants are welcome from all manner of backgrounds that have a connection with offshore (or ocean) technology, ranging from underwater technology, marine and ocean science, underwater robotics, renewable energy, offshore and subsea infrastructure, metocean and many more.
To be eligible for a scholarship, applicants must be studying full time and either in the final two years of undergraduate studies or engaged in post-graduate study in Semester 1 of the following year at an Australian tertiary institution in Australia or New Zealand.
Read more and apply
.
Closing 13 August 2026
Business School Māori and Pacific Tautoko Grant
Grants of up to $2,500 each to assist undergraduate Māori students and Pacific students enrolled full-time in the Business School.
Apply now
.
James Hodge M & P Paykel Trust Research Scholarship in Medical and Health Sciences
Three Scholarships of up to $7,500 for New Zealand Citizens or Permanent Residents enrolled in honours or masters research in a medical and health sciences field.
Apply now
.
Martyn Finlay Memorial Scholarship
A Scholarship to support a domestic or international student enrolled in Part III of an LLB who is experiencing financial hardship.
Apply now
.
Closing 18 August 2026
Sir William Tyree Scholarship in Engineering
A Scholarship to support a domestic student enrolled in Part II of a BE(Hons) in the Department of Electrical, Computer and Software Engineering in 2026.
Apply now
.
Closing 19 August 2026
James LeGallais New Start Award
An Award to assist male students who are New Zealand Citizens or Permanent Residents enrolling in the New Start programme.
Apply now
.
University Preparation Award – New Start
A $1,000 Award to assist New Start Programme students with demonstrated financial need.
Apply now
.
Closing 20 August 2026
Kupe Leadership Scholarship
The Kupe Leadership Scholarship offers a transformational opportunity of personal development and growth alongside Honours, Masters, or Postgraduate Diploma study, for students who care deeply about Aotearoa New Zealand, want to make an impact and create a brighter future.
Scholarships of up to around $25,000 each including accommodation plus a Leadership Development and mentoring programme.
Read more and apply
.
Closing 27 August 2026
Arthur Thomas Paterson Award in Ophthalmology
An Award of up to $20,000 to support a Vocational Trainee in Ophthalmology with the costs of overseas postgraduate training.
Apply now
.
Maurice and Phyllis Paykel Trust PhD Research Travel Award
An Award to support a final year PhD student, who is a New Zealand Citizen or Permanent Resident, with the costs of travel for research in a medical related field. Travel is to be undertaken in 2027.
Apply now
.
Closing 31 August 2026
RHT Bates Postgraduate Scholarship
An award of $6,000 for a PhD in the Physical Sciences and Engineering in a New Zealand university.
Read more and apply
.
The Sir Hugh Kawharu Masters Scholarship for Innovation in Science
The Sir Hugh Kawharu Scholarship for Innovation in Science, administered by Royal Society Te Apārangi, is a $10,000 scholarship for study at masters level in the sciences. The Scholarship is applicable across a broad range of science disciplines including the physical, mathematical and computational, earth, environment, marine, social, health, biological, biomedical, human, and behavioural sciences.
Read more and apply
.
Zonta Club of South Auckland Awards
Zonta Club of South Auckland offers three awards for women who live in the area bounded by Sylvia Park Road in the north, on the west side of the motorway and south to Redoubt Road, continuing roughly straight east to Kawakawa Bay. Then on each side of the motorway as far as a line roughly through Port Waikato east to Maramarua.
Young Woman's Leadership Award
An Award of up to $1,000 is offered to a young woman leader aged 16-20 years who has proven leadership ability in school and /or community settings. The award will assist in enhancing leadership skills through further study, attending a course or participating in an experience.
Young Woman's Study Award
An Award of up to $1,000 is offered to a young woman leader aged 16-25 years to assist in financing a female student’s first post-secondary school course, leading to a professional or vocational qualification. This award is primarily targeted at a student intending to complete a vocational or trade qualification, but applicants aiming for university study will also be considered.
Study Award
An Award of up to $5,000 to a woman aged 25-45 to assist in financing a student to undertake a course of study towards a professional or vocational qualification of any sort. The award is intended to primarily target a woman who is hoping to begin or to complete a course of study which she was unable to undertake immediately after leaving school.
For any inquiries and an application form please email:
southauckland@zonta.org.nz
Closing 9 September 2026
University of Auckland Languages and Cultures Study Abroad Award
An Award to assist undergraduate or postgraduate languages students from the Faculty of Arts and Education to undertake a period of formal study overseas.
Apply now
.
Closing 1 October 2026
New Zealand Seniors Aged Care Futures Grant
A Grant of $5,000 for a New Zealand Citizen or Permanent Resident, aged 18 years or older, who is enrolled full-time in an undergraduate degree or diploma in either Aged Care, Aged Care Nursing, Dementia Care, Disabilities Care, or any other courses leading to similar careers as an aged carer.
Read more and apply
.
New Zealand Refugee Health Scholarship Programme
The scholarship supports former refugees and their children in Aotearoa New Zealand to pursue health-related qualifications (Level 7 and above), helping to strengthen the refugee health workforce and improve health outcomes for refugee communities.
Eligible applicants may receive:
Up to NZD $5,000 towards course-related costs (including tuition, compulsory fees, and equipment), and
Up to NZD $20,000 as a living stipend for one academic year.
Online information webinars are available on:
25 June 2026, 12.00-12.30pm (NZST) Register
here
.
2 September 2026, 12.00-12.30pm (NZST) Register
here
.
Applications open 1 July 2026 and close on 1 October 2026.
Read more and apply
.
Closing 4 October 2026
Te Waiu o Aotearoa Trust Scholarship 2027
Te Waiu o Aotearoa Trust is offering $5,000 scholarships to promote, develop and provide for the education and advancement of Māori in the general business, banking, and finance industries.
Up to four Māori recipients throughout Aotearoa could be awarded a $5,000 scholarship towards their tertiary study costs in 2027.
Read more and apply
.
